goal: Close CI coverage and provider launch gaps reported in issue 178
asset: Forge source evidence and pinned coverage
scope: Pinned executable dependency closure including dot directories and pytest config
Typed static Python scans without comment or identifier false dependencies
Pinned configuration for prove:ci and refusal of restarted/manual Woodpecker pipelines
outOfScope: Trusting a pinned CI identity whose tokens or server restart credentials are available to agents

record.question: What establishes that the pinned CI status ran the reviewed check configuration?

options.strongest_objection: Private provider APIs can be unavailable, requiring a local fallback
A restarted pipeline can skip tests and honestly post green

record.rationale: Bind all source citations to reviewed blobs, preserve static executable closure and inspect observable provider restart metadata.
evidence: Issue178 reproduces hidden-directory script omission and mutable prove:ci config
Woodpecker pipeline parent reveals restarts but not caller environment values

costs.cost: One bounded provider observation for a pinned Woodpecker green and static dependency checks
evidence: Existing GitHub tree/blob coverage handles source pinning

requirements.statement: Dot-directory script dependencies and all pytest config names must be pinned; comments and ordinary literal attribute access do not introduce phantom imports.
requirements.counterexample: CI invokes an omitted .ci/run.sh or new pytest.toml and coverage accepts it

requirements.statement: prove:ci requires pinned config, and a Woodpecker source green is accepted only from an observed original automatic pipeline for the same commit.
requirements.counterexample: A manual restart or changed prove:ci pipeline yields reusable green

checks.scope: In-memory authoritative API fixture and actual static closure scanners
assumptions: Pinned CI identities and CI-server restart credentials are unavailable to agents
Fixtures establish refusal logic, not live provider authorization

challenges.claim: Can a commit status prove its entire CI environment?
challenges.resolution: No. Operator credential isolation remains required; observable restarted/manual Woodpecker pipelines are refused and unavailable metadata cannot green.
